name: Ormer Ironbraid
summary: At Whelgar's Excavation Site, Ormer Ironbraid holds his ground against the raptors that drove the dwarven workers away. He seeks allies to reclaim the dig.

sections.title: A Dig Derailed
sections.body: Ormer Ironbraid came to the Wetlands with the dwarves who seek Titan relics and ancient history at Whelgar's Excavation Site. Their work stirred fierce raptors, or drew the beasts to the dig. Now raptors prowl the ruins where Ormer's team hoped to study ancient earthenware and tablets. Their presence has halted the work, and Ormer's anger runs deep.

sections.title: A Bitter Feud with Claws
sections.body: Ormer will not leave the dig, though he cannot drive out the raptors alone. He asks travelers to kill them, starting with the smaller beasts and moving on to larger, fiercer ones. The artifacts remain to be recovered, but the fight is personal now. Ormer wants vengeance for the work disrupted and the dwarven pride wounded by the raptors' presence.

faq.answer: Ormer Ironbraid oversees dwarven research at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands. The dig studies ancient ruins buried in the marsh.

faq.q: Where can I find Ormer Ironbraid?
faq.answer: Ormer stands on the overlook above Whelgar's Excavation Site in the southern Wetlands cliffs, just east of the main road toward Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why does Ormer hate raptors so much?
faq.answer: Raptor packs overran the excavation, drove out the dwarven workers, and halted the archaeological work. Ormer took the disruption as a personal insult and wants payback.

Whelgar's Excavation Site is an archaeological dig founded by Ironforge dwarves to uncover ancient Titan and earthen ruins beneath the Wetlands. Aggressive wildlife has made the site a dangerous battleground.
Ormer asks travelers to kill ever-larger raptors at the excavation in a three-part chain called 'Ormer's Revenge.'

faq.q: Is Ormer affiliated with the Explorers' League?
faq.answer: Yes. Ormer works on behalf of Ironforge's archaeological efforts to uncover the dwarves' Titan heritage, like many dwarves excavating ancient ruins across Khaz Modan.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the tenacity it takes to refuse ground to a pack of overgrown lizards.
Helping Ormer secures the southern Wetlands road and supports Ironforge's archaeological work.
As a hunter, you can bring your tracking and beast-slaying skills to Ormer's fight against some of Khaz Modan's fiercest raptors.
